Distribution and habitat. The species is known only from Gyirong County in southern Xizang (Fig. 10 I). The specimen was collected by sifting leaf litter at altitudes of 2400 – 2700 m. Comparative notes. The new species is similar in general appearance and aedeagus to N. elegans Coiffait, 1975, but can be separated by smaller body size (body length 6.8 – 7.3 mm in N. elegans); the wider apex and deeper apical concave of ventral process of aedeagus in ventral view (Figs 5 C, D).
